question: Where was the SAFF Women's Championship 2019 held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nepal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **South Asian Football Federation(SAFF)** **Women's championship 2019 **was held in the **Biratnagar district of Nepal**.
 
• **India became the winner **of the event after defeating **Nepal by 3-1**.
 
• SAFF Women's championship is **played after every 2 years.**
 
• This championship started **in 2010 and India has won all the titles till 2019.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **South Asian Football Federation(SAFF)** is an association of football-playing countries in S**outh Asia which was founded in 1997**.
 
• Its headquarters are located in **Dhaka (Bangladesh)**.
 
• **Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan and Sri Lanka **are member countries of **SAFF.**
 
• **Kazi Salahuddin** is the current president of **SAFF**.
 
• The next **South Asian Football Federation(SAFF)** **Women's **championship will be held in **2022 in Nepal**.
 
• **Loitongbam Ashalata Devi **is the captain of the **Indian National women's football team**.
